skill.summary: Add real references and standardize citations for research papers and theses (为科研论文和毕业论文添加真实参考文献并规范引用标注)

latestVersion.changelog:
支持7种引用格式、智能元数据获取、批量管理
Initial release of Academic Citation Manager.
- Add real references and standardize citations for research papers and theses.
- Supports multiple citation formats: APA, MLA, Chicago, GB/T 7714, IEEE, and Harvard.
- Integrates with Crossref API for automatic bibliographic metadata retrieval.
- Generates and manages in-text citations and bibliography lists.
- Supports batch reference import, format conversion, and citation integrity checking.
- Offers bilingual support for both Chinese and English references.
